channel.title: North Wales Chronicle - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Chronicle (northwaleschronicle.co.uk)

item.title: Huge £10.4m investment green-lit to regenerate Porth Amlwch
item.description: The former Marine Terminal Building at Porth Amlwch will be refurbished and 10 business units at the nearby Industrial Estate will be built.

item.title: Hot water bottle warning as recall issued due to 'serious fire risk'
item.description: The UK Office for Product Safety and Standards (OPSS) issued the alert for the hot water bottle, which was listed on TikTok Shop

item.title: Will my car insurance cover damage caused by potholes?
item.description: Potholes are one of the biggest annoyances on the roads for UK drivers, not only are they uncomfortable to drive they can often cause serious damage to your car.

item.title: Starbucks viral Bearista cup that hit UK stores today already £650 on eBay
item.description: Starbucks glass Bearista cups hit the UK today and some are already for sale on eBay for more than £650, with 'loads' on Vinted for more than £100

item.title: Greater transport connection across the Irish Sea between ports
item.description: The Irish Sea Resilience Taskforce, launched in response to the temporary closure of Holyhead Port in December 2024, has published its recommendations aimed at strengthening transport connections between Wales and Ireland.

item.title: Concert to shine spotlight on powerful story of hope and sanctuary
item.description: A concert will shine a spotlight on a powerful story of hope and sanctuary.

item.title: New tourism rules facing criticism over concerns such as rising costs
item.description: A new Tourism Bill is facing criticism amid concerns it could add regulatory burdens to the industry.

item.title: Olympic gold medallist becomes cycling ambassador ahead of event's premiere in Wales
item.description: An Olympic champion has been appointed as a cycling ambassador.

item.title: Bangor man, 33, admits threatening to share intimate footage of a woman
item.description: A man from Bangor has admitted threatening to share footage of a woman in an intimate state.

item.title: Six Gwynedd Council departments overspend as council projects £2.3m shortfall
item.description: The cabinet will also be asked to approve a transfer of £3.365 million of underspend on corporate budgets to the council’s Financial Strategy Support Fund, to be used at the end of the financial year to fund the overspend faced by the departments.
